intro: A DevOps engineer resume that measures infrastructure work in reliability, speed and cost: the outcomes engineering leaders care about.
tips: Measure work in uptime, deploy frequency, recovery time and cost.
Name the scale: services, clusters, traffic, spend.
Show what you automated and how much time it saved.

basics.name: Lars Eriksson
basics.label: DevOps Engineer
basics.summary: DevOps engineer with seven years running Kubernetes platforms on AWS and GCP. Took deploys from weekly to 40 a day, and cut cloud spend by 30% without slowing teams down.

work.name: Nordbank Digital
highlights: Built the CI/CD platform 25 teams deploy with; from weekly releases to 40 deploys a day.
Cut AWS spend by 30% ($600k a year) with rightsizing, spot capacity and better autoscaling.
Led incident response improvements; mean time to recovery fell from 2 hours to 25 minutes.

work.name: Spelfabriken
highlights: Moved game servers from VMs to Kubernetes on GCP, handling launch peaks of 2 million players.
Automated environment setup with Terraform, from two days to 20 minutes.
